name: Source Inspector
description: Interface for inspecting binding source artifacts before an OpenBindings interface exists. A source inspector reports its supported binding specifications and discovers bindable targets that tooling can offer to users.

BindingSpecInfo.description: Information about a supported binding specification.

bindingSpec.description: Binding specification identifier, exact and opaque (e.g., openbindings.openapi@1, openbindings.mcp@1).

description.description: Human-readable description of this binding specification.

kind.description: The source's kind: exact, opaque, non-empty string used to select an interpretation of the source and its bindings (e.g., example.openapi@1). Never implicitly dereferenced; no version algebra.

content.description: Optional source content, as any JSON value, read under the source's kind. The core assigns no meaning to its presence, absence, type, or members. Member presence is distinct from value: content carrying JSON null is a present member.

Source.description: An OBI source, carried by value. Its exact kind selects the interpretation of source and binding content; content may be absent or any JSON value, including null. The schema carries the source shape; core document conformance additionally governs allowed extension members.

Operation.description: Potential OpenBindings operation framing for a bindable target.

BindableTarget.description: A target admitted by the source's governing binding specification that can be framed as an OpenBindings operation. Any included framing is a sound projection of this same target.

content.description: Kind-owned content for a binding that realizes this target. Absence means the binding omits content; null is a present value.

operationKey.description: Suggested operation key for this target.

SourceInspection.description: Inspection result for a binding source artifact. Its inventory boundary is the targets admitted by the governing binding specification, not every interaction in the upstream artifact.

exhaustive.description: True when targets is the complete list of targets admitted by the governing binding specification. False means more admitted targets may exist and requires limitation evidence.

InspectionLimitation.description: Machine-readable evidence explaining why a source inspection is not exhaustive.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of what may be missing and why.

details.description: Optional implementation- or family-specific structured evidence.

openbindings.source-inspector.listBindin.description: List the binding specifications this inspector can inspect, by exact identifier. This operation is idempotent: repeating it with the same input in context that does not change its intended effects produces no additional intended operation-level effects after the first application. This does not promise identical results or authorize retries.

openbindings.source-inspector.inspectSou.description: Inspect a binding source artifact and return targets admitted by its governing binding specification, optionally with sound operation framing. The result states whether enumeration is exhaustive and explains any partial result. This operation is idempotent: repeating it with the same input in context that does not change its intended effects produces no additional intended operation-level effects after the first application. This does not promise identical results or authorize retries.
